desc.terracraft_geo.wheel: Vehicle part: 4 for a car or truck, 2 for a motorcycle. Right-click the chassis.
desc.terracraft_geo.engine: Required part for ground vehicles and the plane. Right-click the chassis.
desc.terracraft_geo.radiator: Required part for ground vehicles. Right-click the chassis.
desc.terracraft_geo.battery: Required part for ground vehicles; also used by the jetpack, plane and rover.
desc.terracraft_geo.turbo: Vehicle upgrade: +40% top speed and quicker acceleration.
desc.terracraft_geo.fuel_can: Petrol: right-click a vehicle, the plane or the jetpack to refuel. You get the empty can back.
desc.terracraft_geo.car_chassis: Place it on the ground, then add engine, radiator, battery, 4 wheels and petrol.
desc.terracraft_geo.truck_chassis: Slow truck with a large trunk (V key). Same parts as the car.
desc.terracraft_geo.motorcycle_chassis: Fast, light motorcycle: engine, radiator, battery and 2 wheels.
desc.terracraft_geo.pistol: Magazine handgun. Ammo from your inventory; automatic reload.
desc.terracraft_geo.rifle: Magazine rifle, accurate at medium range.
desc.terracraft_geo.shotgun: Pump shotgun: devastating at short range, several pellets per shot.
desc.terracraft_geo.rocket_hull: Base of a rocket: place it, then add rocket engine, tank, nose cone and fins.
desc.terracraft_geo.rocket_engine: Rocket part: right-click the placed hull.
desc.terracraft_geo.rocket_tank: Rocket part (1 to 4 tanks: 8 to 20 doses); also used for spaceship fuel tanks.
desc.terracraft_geo.nose_cone: Rocket part: right-click the placed hull.
desc.terracraft_geo.fins: Rocket part: right-click the placed hull.
desc.terracraft_geo.rocket_fuel: One dose of space fuel: right-click a rocket or a spaceship fuel tank.
desc.terracraft_geo.space_helmet: Essential in space: holds your oxygen reserve (J key).
desc.terracraft_geo.oxygen_tank: Refills the helmet's oxygen; two reserves fit in the suit (J key).
desc.terracraft_geo.titanium_ore: Ore from the Moon. Smelts into titanium ingots.
desc.terracraft_geo.helium3_crystals: Glowing lunar crystals: mine them for helium-3 shards.
desc.terracraft_geo.station_hull: Space station wall, airtight and sturdy.
desc.terracraft_geo.station_window: Station window: see space without losing oxygen.
desc.terracraft_geo.station_light: Bright light for stations and bases.
desc.terracraft_geo.oxygen_distributor: Provides breathable air within 8 blocks (stations, bases, spaceships).
desc.terracraft_geo.titanium_ingot: Light, strong metal: stations, Mars bases, rocket blueprints.
desc.terracraft_geo.helium3_shard: Lunar fuel: 4 shards make one dose of rocket fuel; used by blueprints.
desc.terracraft_geo.smg: Submachine gun: high rate of fire, poor at long range.
desc.terracraft_geo.sniper: Sniper rifle with scope (zoom while aiming). Very powerful, slow to reload.
desc.terracraft_geo.grenade: Throw it (right-click): explodes after a short delay.
desc.terracraft_geo.machete: Fast melee weapon, handy against zombies.
desc.terracraft_geo.space_suit: Space suit: protects from vacuum and cold (J key).
desc.terracraft_geo.magnetic_boots: Keep you on the floor in orbital stations.
desc.terracraft_geo.jetpack: Hold Jump to fly; refuel it with a petrol can.
desc.terracraft_geo.plane_kit: Plane: place it, refuel it and fly with the keyboard (on-screen instruments).
desc.terracraft_geo.station_beacon: Arrival point for your rockets and spaceships (and your town's). Protects 48 blocks around.
desc.terracraft_geo.station_module: Builds a 7 × 5 × 7 pressurised module in space (oxygen included).
desc.terracraft_geo.station_workshop: Installs unlocked blueprints (/plans) on a rocket or spaceship parked nearby.
desc.terracraft_geo.airlock_door: Airtight station door: opens by hand.
desc.terracraft_geo.docking_clamp: Marks the pad where rockets land.
desc.terracraft_geo.orbital_station_kit: Load it in a rocket (or carry it aboard a spaceship): the station deploys on the first orbital flight.
desc.terracraft_geo.rover_kit: Electric rover for the Moon and Mars: solar recharge when parked.
desc.terracraft_geo.lunar_base_kit: Complete lunar base deployed when landing on the Moon.
desc.terracraft_geo.mars_base_kit: Complete Mars base deployed when landing on Mars.
desc.terracraft_geo.alien_stone: Stone from the alien sanctuaries on the Moon.
desc.terracraft_geo.alien_glyph: Engraved stone from the alien sanctuaries.
desc.terracraft_geo.alien_artifact: Found in lunar sanctuaries; required by Mars navigation.
desc.terracraft_geo.commander_badge: Trophy of the bunker Commander. Sells for a lot.
desc.terracraft_geo.market_stall: Your shop: sells one item from its stock at a fixed price, even while you're away (/etal).
desc.terracraft_geo.oil_pump: Placed on a deposit and powered, it extracts crude oil.
desc.terracraft_geo.refinery: Turns crude oil into petrol and kerosene (needs power).
desc.terracraft_geo.fuel_tank: Stores liquids (oil, petrol); connect it with pipes.
desc.terracraft_geo.fuel_pump: Fills empty cans with petrol from a connected tank.
desc.terracraft_geo.solar_panel: Produces power during the day; connect it with cables.
desc.terracraft_geo.pipe: Carries liquids between machines (networks of about 1,000 blocks).
desc.terracraft_geo.cable: Carries power between machines and lamps.
desc.terracraft_geo.oil_puddle: Sign of an oil deposit beneath your feet.
desc.terracraft_geo.empty_fuel_can: Fill it at a fuel pump.
desc.terracraft_geo.oil_detector: Shows the direction and richness of the nearest oil deposit.
desc.terracraft_geo.generator: Burns petrol to produce power when the sun is missing.
desc.terracraft_geo.electric_lamp: Lights up when its network has power.
desc.terracraft_geo.logistics_terminal: Your town's shared storage: the same in every terminal, from Earth to the Moon.
desc.terracraft_geo.greenhouse: Grows food with power, even in space; the harvest goes into an adjacent chest.
desc.terracraft_geo.ship_hull: Spaceship hull. A spaceship is a build made of spaceship blocks.
desc.terracraft_geo.ship_hull_stripe: Spaceship hull with an orange stripe.
desc.terracraft_geo.ship_canopy: Tinted canopy for cockpits and portholes.
desc.terracraft_geo.ship_thruster: Thruster: one needed per 60 blocks of spaceship. The nozzle faces you when placed.
desc.terracraft_geo.pilot_seat: Sit down (right-click) to fly the spaceship.
desc.terracraft_geo.nav_console: Heart of the spaceship: right-click for the star map and take-off. Receives workshop blueprints.
desc.terracraft_geo.spaceship_kit: Builds a complete shuttle in front of you, ready to be fuelled.
desc.terracraft_geo.ship_hull_slope: Hull slope for streamlined shapes; placed like stairs.
desc.terracraft_geo.ship_canopy_slope: Sloped canopy for a streamlined cockpit.
desc.terracraft_geo.ship_fuel_tank: Spaceship fuel tank: 5 doses of rocket fuel. Keeps its fuel when broken.
desc.terracraft_geo.ship_airlock: Spaceship airlock: when docking, it lines up with the station's airlock.
desc.terracraft_geo.town_registry: Right-click: your town, the current mayoral election and voting. Place it in your town hall.
